Parseval yields the exact norm; the angular sine phase has strictly positive second derivative in negative logarithmic Poisson radius, giving strict mixed differences and unique semicircle optimization for every positive nonidentity mixture. Equality forces atomic antipodal derivative signs. Closed dilogarithm and three fractional small-time constants follow by exact differentiation, dominated convergence, harmonic split and an integrable odd-mesh Riemann sum. Standalone checker passed 32 mixed symbolic and numerical assertions; numerical assertions are not universal proof.
